name: whatsapp-service-workspace
description: Verifinder Fullstack Workspace - Angular Frontend & WhatsApp Gateway Service

scripts.build: node scripts/run.js verifinder npm run build && node scripts/run.js service npm run build
scripts.build:client: node scripts/run.js verifinder npm run build
scripts.build:server: node scripts/run.js service npm run build
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/run.js service npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix verifinder && npm install --prefix service
